part.text:
## Summary

Refactored the SSG to a plugin architecture:

- **`src/plugin.ts`** — `Plugin` interface with `onStart`/`beforeBuild`/`onFile`/`afterBuild`/`onEnd` hooks, plus `PluginContext` and `PageDraft` types.
- **`src/engine.ts`** — `SSGEngine` orchestrates the pipeline: `beforeBuild`→per-file `onFile`→`afterBuild` run synchronously (so `buildPage`/`build` stay sync, matching the old API); `onStart`/`onEnd` are async and bracket a process lifetime (used only by the dev server).
- **`plugins/markdown-plugin.ts`, `plugins/template-plugin.ts`, `plugins/dev-server-plugin.ts`** — the old markdown rendering, template/layout rendering + index generation, and dev-server/live-reload logic extracted verbatim into built-in plugins.
- **`ssg.config.ts`** + **`src/config.ts`** — `loadConfig()` reads the plugin list from `ssg.config.ts` in the cwd, falling back to built-in markdown+template plugins if absent; lazily registers `ts-node` so the compiled CLI can still load a `.ts` config without a pre-existing TS loader.
- **`src/build.ts`/`src/serve.ts`** — reimplemented on top of `SSGEngine`/`loadConfig`, with unchanged public signatures (`build`, `buildPage`, `findMarkdownFiles`, `startServer`).
- CLI (`src/cli.ts`), `templates.ts`, `markdown.ts`, `frontmatter.ts`, `types.ts` untouched — external API is identical.
- Adjusted `tsconfig.build.json`/`package.json` so `plugins/` and `ssg.config.ts` compile into `dist-bin` correctly, and verified the compiled CLI + dev server work end-to-end (build, serve, live reload) via manual smoke tests.
- Added `tests/plugin.test.ts` covering hook ordering, draft mutation, and config fallback.
